sonnet.problem: The answer to this blank, 'medium', is already given on card 1, which says Saul 'removed the mediums and spiritists from the land.' The baker can fill the blank from that card alone.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Card 12 already asked what the woman wants to do for Saul (set bread before him). Card 16 asks the same fact again, that she prepares food, and card 17 then retells it.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
